reason: A answers my main doubt directly with facts: in 14 counties the nearest chain is more than 20 miles away, and two pharmacies say they will stop filling for plan members. It also makes concrete, checkable offers, invoices and a meeting before May 1, signed by a named owner. B leaves out the chain-distance fact, uses placeholders, adds a disclosure demand that wasn't in the brief, and claims members will 'go without their medicine', which sounds like the usual annual complaint.
